name: TPS62933
description: 30 V, 3 A synchronous buck in a tiny SOT-583 with 12 µA quiescent current and adjustable 200 kHz–2.2 MHz switching: good for battery robots.
notes: RT pin: float = 500 kHz, GND = 1.2 MHz, or a resistor for 200 kHz–2.2 MHz.
Pin 7 is soft-start (SS) on TPS62933; the TPS62933P variant has a power-good pin there instead, TPS62933F is forced PWM.
0.5 mm pitch SOT-583: needs a fine-pitch stencil.

en.note: Internal pull-up current Ip = 0.7 µA (enabled when floating) plus Ih = 1.4 µA hysteresis current above threshold. Rising threshold 1.21 V typ, falling 1.17 V typ. EN abs max 6 V, recommended max 5.5 V, so EN must NOT be tied to VIN. The reference design µses a UVLO divider R1 = 511k (VIN-EN), R2 = 88.7k (EN-GND) for 8 V start / 7 V stop (the text says 80.7k; Eq. 4 gives about 86.6k, so the schematic's 88.7k looks right). Divider eqs: R1 = (VSTART*VEN_FALL/VEN_RISE - VSTOP) / (Ip*(1 - VEN_FALL/VEN_RISE) + Ih); R2 = R1*VEN_FALL / (VSTOP - VEN_FALL + R1*(Ip+Ih)). Check VEN = (R2*VIN + R1*R2*(Ip+Ih))/(R1+R2) < 5.5 V at max VIN. Datasheet recommends > 500 mV hysteresis when µsing external UVLO. For always-on, leave EN floating.

extras.note: Floating (> 280 kΩ) gives 500 kHz (450-550 kHz). RT = GND (< 1 kΩ) gives 1.2 MHz. With a resistor RT to GND (8.9k-111k) fSW(kHz) = 17293 x RT(kΩ)^-0.942 (Eq. 2), 200 kHz to 2.2 MHz; 500 kHz from the formula would be about 43 kΩ. RT is sampled only at power-up / EN toggle.

Required, do not float. tSS = CSS x VREF / ISS (Eq. 6), VREF = 0.8 V, ISS = 5.5 µA. The reference design µses 33 nF, about 5 ms (4.8 ms calc). Minimum 6.8 nF, which gives about 1 ms. There is no internal default soft-start on TPS62933 (only the PG variants TPS62933P/O have a fixed 2 ms).

notes: Peak-current-mode with internal compensation. No COMP pin.

Inductor: L >= (VIN - VOUT)/(fSW x K x IOUT_MAX) x VOUT/VIN (Eq. 16) at VIN_MAX. Use K = 0.2-0.6, best 0.4. The design example µses 6.8 µH for 5 V/3 A at 500 kHz (from 30 V). Keep ripple >= about 10% of 3 A to avoid subharmonic oscillation. Isat ideally >= IHS_LIMIT (5.8 A max).

Table 10-2 COUT values are EFFECTIVE (derated) capacitance. Minimum effective COUT at 500 kHz is 15 µF (3.3 V) and 10 µF (5 V, 12 V). The design example µses 2 x 22 µF 35 V X5R 1206 plus 100 nF on the output.
RFBT = (VOUT - VREF)/VREF x RFBB (Eq. 1). Recommended RFBB = 10k with RFBT in 10k-300k. Use 1% resistors.
CFF: optional across RFBT to improve transient/phase margin, especially when RFBT > 100k. The design example says a 10 pF can be mounted (shown DNP on the schematic).
Input: 10 µF typical decoupling plus 0.1 µF VIN-GND directly at the pins. The design example µses 2 x 10 µF 50 V X7R 1206 plus 100 nF. Cap voltage rating must exceed VIN max.
BST: 0.1 µF X5R or better, >= 16 V. An optional series resistor < 10 Ω between BST and the cap reduces SW spikes (the reference design places R4 = 0 Ω).
Frequency foldback at minimum on-time. Approximate VIN max before foldback = VOUT/(tON_MIN x fSW) (Eq. 13).
PFM at light load (TPS62933). The TPS62933F variant is FCCM.
IHS_LIMIT 4.2/5/5.8 A min/typ/max. Low-side (valley) limit 3.8 A typ.
VFB 0.8 V +/-1% at 25 C (784-816 mV over -40 to 150 C). 98% max duty cycle is from the Features list.
SS must never be left floating (What to Do list p38).
